title: Bud Russo and Little Dad with Punch Miller
summary: Bud Russo played bass and later in church; Little Dad played banjo with Punch until Punch left for Chicago.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: What about old Bud Russo, remember him?

Yeah, I remember Bud just played bass years ago. Sure stuff But the birth of that was in 44. That's been a long time. I haven't seen the birth for a long while. But last time I see it, Buddy told me he had joined church and he was playing his bass in the church. He told me.
It was the time the war was going on. What about little dad? Remember little dad played banjo?
Oh yeah. Little dad was a good little banjo player. Little dad was playing banjo with punch at the time then.
Oh yeah. Little punter. Yeah. That was him. This is real Floyd Jim Robinson huh? Yeah. What were we talking about? We were talking about little dad when we stopped.
Little dad, yeah. Played with punch huh? Yeah. He played with punch. Dad played with punch until punch left and he had to go to Chicago. And the band broke up then after that. Watch that.
